auditStandard: Forensic Engineering Truth Reconciliation & Independent Reference Audit

capabilities.name: B-Rep Fillet Edge Blend & Topology Reconstruction
capabilities.reconciliationNotes: Implementation constructs correct blend geometry (cylindrical surfaces) but fails to rewire the shell topology (shared edges not split). Resulting solid is non-manifold despite passing status check in tests. Downgraded from CLOSED_PROVEN to PROVEN_PARTIAL.

capabilities.name: NURBS Cox-de Boor Knot Insertion & Parametric Evaluation
capabilities.reconciliationNotes: Mathematical invariance against independent reference (De Boor) is verified across the entire domain. Bridge from insertion to evaluator is fully operational.

capabilities.name: CAD Tooling Mold Split & Draft Angle Verification
capabilities.reconciliationNotes: MoldEngine.performMoldSplit is correctly integrated with the UI tool contract. Volumetric conservation and draft rejection are proven.

capabilities.name: Industrial OS Evidence Envelope Integrity
capabilities.reconciliationNotes: Mock token 'ev-manual-sandbox' eradicated. EvidenceBus.publishSync() is strictly enforced for state transitions.

capabilities.name: B-Rep Reconstruction Workbench Canonical Initialization
capabilities.reconciliationNotes: Static identifiers removed, but the workbench initialization remains a presentation-layer demo state. It does not constitute a proven engineering 'capability' beyond UI hygiene. Downgraded from CLOSED_PROVEN to NOT_PROVEN.

capabilities.name: Feature Recognition Workbench Canonical Mesh State
capabilities.reconciliationNotes: Similar to CAP-005, this is a UI-level hygiene fix. The underlying recognition capability is not independently verified in this pass. Downgraded from CLOSED_PROVEN to NOT_PROVEN.

capabilities.name: FEA Global Stiffness Matrix Assembly Engine
capabilities.reconciliationNotes: StiffnessMatrixEngine provides accurate element stiffness and global assembly. Symmetry and trace positivity confirmed.

capabilities.name: FEA Displacement Field Analysis & Spatial Interpolation
capabilities.reconciliationNotes: Linear shape function interpolation and nodal summarization are verified against analytical mid-point references.

capabilities.name: Structural Physics Automated FEA Validation Engine
capabilities.reconciliationNotes: Real validation logic replacing hardcoded 'return true'. Rejects non-equilibrium states and BC violations.

capabilities.name: EPC Digital Twin Deterministic Mission Evidence Hashing
capabilities.reconciliationNotes: SHA-256 evidence hashing is deterministic and sensitive to input mutations. Timeout issues in tests resolved by increased limits.

capabilities.name: CFD 3D NACA0012 Transonic Physical Validation
capabilities.reconciliationNotes: Sophisticated SIMPLE/SST k-omega solver exists and is stable, but physical Lift/Drag polar validation against experimental data (NASA TMR) requires more rigorous grid-independent evidence. Upgraded from REQUIRED_GAP to PROVEN_PARTIAL.

capabilities.name: CFD Convergence Audit Limiter Telemetry
capabilities.reconciliationNotes: Velocity/Pressure clamp counters are accurately recorded and exported in structured telemetry.

capabilities.name: CFD Fail-Fast First Invalid Cell Diagnostic
capabilities.reconciliationNotes: Diagnostic capture of first invalid cell (ID, coordinates, iteration) is verified on simulated divergence.
